newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Workers return at strike-hit ET Cons mines.
newsitem.headline: Workers return at strike-hit ET Cons mines.

text.p: Miners returned to work at three of Avgold Ltd's Eastern Transvaal Consolidated Mines Ltd for the Monday night shift following a one-day strike, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.
"A settlement was reached yesterday afternoon and work resumed normally last night...We've basically lost one day (production)," the spokesman told Reuters.

South Africa's National Union of Mineworkers said on Monday that about 2,000 mineworkers had gone on strike to protest against the company's handling of a disciplinary matter concerning a hostel manager.
ET Cons produced 617 kg of gold in the three months to end-December.
